thread:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — GCP marketplace invoice for July shows a negative line-item totaling -$12,450 labeled `promo_adjustment` for reseller CloudEdge. looks like credits exceeded charges on their consolidated invoice. link: https://gcs.redwood.internal/billing/gcp/2026-07/CLOUD_EDGE_INV_0726.pdf
Liam O'Connor: yikes. do we have the raw usage/adjustment export from the partner? cc @Sofia Alvarez
Sofia Alvarez: pulling it now. partner sent an adjustments CSV earlier, but my quick grep shows a `promo-ledger-v3` tag in their notes. could be experiment-related.
Priya Rao: can we pause any auto-rebilling to avoid issuing a negative settlement? @finance-bot can you place a temporary hold and open a tracking ticket?
finance-bot: Hold placed. Created ticket FIN-4791. Auto-settlement disabled for reseller CloudEdge for July pending investigation.
billing-ops: tagging in ops — please don't auto-apply credits until a reconciled ledger is posted.
gcp-partner: Confirmed — we ran a targeted promo rollback on July 22 as part of a pricing experiment. That rollback created adjustment entries that were netted incorrectly when aggregated into the marketplace statement. We're investigating on our side and will share raw adjustment ids.
Sofia Alvarez: snippet from partner CSV (redacted):
```
adjustment_id,reason,amount_usd,related_charge_id
adj_99321,promo_rollback,-12450,chr_77821
```
Looks like their aggregator applied the rollback as a negative charge instead of an out-of-band credit, which our ingestion treats differently.
Liam O'Connor: ballpark exposure if we need to refund/credit?
Priya Rao: worst-case ~12.5k. recommend provisional approval to net up to $13k while they produce reconciled ledger.
Liam O'Connor: approving provisional settlement/credit up to $13,000. include in July P&L motioning. :+1:
Sofia Alvarez: I'll run a quick SQL to see if our ingestion normalized these entries incorrectly:
```
SELECT count(*), sum(amount_usd) FROM marketplace_adjustments WHERE partner_id='cloudedge' AND period='2026-07' AND source='gcp_export';
```
I'll attach results to FIN-4791 in 1h.
deploy-bot: pricing-service v3.4 deployed to staging (sha: d4f7e). feature flag `promo-ledger-v3` toggled for canary customers at 2026-07-22T17:03Z.
gcp-partner: sharing the reconciliation bundle now via secure link. looks like the aggregator pipeline failed to set `adjustment_type=credit` for rollbacks, so they were ingested as negative charges.
Sofia Alvarez: reconcile run finished — our ingestion shows -12450 across 3 line-items, matching partner. I'll export a draft partner-facing credit memo and attach to FIN-4791.
Priya Rao: thanks. finance-bot — please generate a provisional credit memo for CloudEdge for $12,450 and mark FIN-4791 for expedited review.
finance-bot: Provisional credit memo generated and attached to FIN-4791. Status: awaiting sign-off.
Liam O'Connor: signed off. proceed with credit once partner confirms final ledger. include note to experiments team: require canary + reconciliation check before toggling ledger schema flags.
gcp-partner: final ledger uploaded and verified. we've patched aggregator; no further adjustments expected. apologies for the churn.
billing-ops: applied credit as of 2026-08-03. closing FIN-4791 after final audit.
Priya Rao: great work team. filing a short postmortem and noting action item for pricing experiments to add an ingestion compatibility test.
Priya Rao: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
